SELECT "id", "name", "account_id", "contact_id", "stage", "amount", "probability", "close_date", "owner_id", "source", "next_step", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at", count(*) OVER() AS total_count
FROM {{table:deals}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("name"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("next_step"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "stage" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($7::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($7::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($8::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN $5::text = 'name' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "name" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'name' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "name" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'amount' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "amount" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'amount' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "amount" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'probability' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "probability" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'probability' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "probability" END DESC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'close_date' AND $6::text = 'asc' THEN "close_date" END ASC, CASE WHEN $5::text = 'close_date' AND $6::text = 'desc' THEN "close_date" END DESC, id DESC
LIMIT $4::int OFFSET ((($3::int - 1) * $4::int))

SELECT "id", "name", "account_id", "contact_id", "stage", "amount", "probability", "close_date", "owner_id", "source", "next_step", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
FROM {{table:deals}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (coalesce("name"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%' OR coalesce("next_step"::text, '') ILIKE '%' || $1::text || '%')
  AND ($2::text = '' OR "stage" = $2::text)
  AND (NULLIF($3::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($3::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($4::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 5000

SELECT "id", "name", "account_id", "contact_id", "stage", "amount", "probability", "close_date", "owner_id", "source", "next_step", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at" FROM {{table:deals}} WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL

INSERT INTO {{table:deals}} ("name", "account_id", "contact_id", "stage", "amount", "probability", "close_date", "owner_id", "source", "next_step", created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1::text, $2::int, $3::int, $4::text, $5::numeric, $6::int, $7::date, $8::int, $9::text, $10::text, now(), now())
RETURNING "id", "name", "account_id", "contact_id", "stage", "amount", "probability", "close_date", "owner_id", "source", "next_step", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"

UPDATE {{table:deals}}
SET "name" = $2::text, "account_id" = $3::int, "contact_id" = $4::int, "stage" = $5::text, "amount" = $6::numeric, "probability" = $7::int, "close_date" = $8::date, "owner_id" = $9::int, "source" = $10::text, "next_step" = $11::text, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1::int AND deleted_at IS NULL
RETURNING "id", "name", "account_id", "contact_id", "stage", "amount", "probability", "close_date", "owner_id", "source", "next_step", "created_at", "updated_at", "deleted_at"
UPDATE {{table:deals}} SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:deals}} SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE id = ANY($1::int[]) AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL RETURNING id
UPDATE {{table:deals}} SET "stage" = $2::text, updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, "stage"

SELECT count(*)::int AS total, coalesce(sum("amount"), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS total_value, coalesce(avg("amount"), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS average_value, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "stage" = 'prospecting')::int AS status_prospecting, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "stage" = 'qualification')::int AS status_qualification, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "stage" = 'proposal')::int AS status_proposal, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "stage" = 'negotiation')::int AS status_negotiation, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "stage" = 'closed_won')::int AS status_closed_won, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "stage" = 'closed_lost')::int AS status_closed_lost
FROM {{table:deals}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (NULLIF($1::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($1::text, '')::date)
  AND (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date + interval '1 day'))

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at)::date AS day, count(*)::int AS count, coalesce(sum("amount"), 0)::numeric(14,2) AS total
FROM {{table:deals}}
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= coalesce(NULLIF($1::text, '')::date, now() - interval '90 days')
  AND created_at < (coalesce(NULLIF($2::text, '')::date, now()::date) + interval '1 day')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT "stage" AS status, count(*)::int AS count FROM {{table:deals}} WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (NULLIF($1::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at >= NULLIF($1::text, '')::date) AND (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date IS NULL OR created_at < (NULLIF($2::text, '')::date + interval '1 day')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
